up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1744525 (Nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase). Return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Use only exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values, and order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_activities AS (SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.molregno, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_relation FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_relation = '='), relevant_assays AS (SELECT assay_id, chembl_id FROM assays WHERE tid IN (SELECT td.tid FROM target_dictionary td WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1744525' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606)) SELECT ta.assay_id, ra.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, ta.standard_type, ta.pchembl_value FROM target_activities ta JOIN relevant_assays ra ON ta.assay_id = ra.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1744525' JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ta.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON ta.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ra.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
